messages:
Lina (DevEx): quick design sync: prototyping a 'param pill' for collapsed function defs in playground. goal: surface required count and allow keyboard reveal. attaching tiny mock.
Omar (Design): nice! i think the pill should read '2 required' and use a hover tooltip 'press enter to expand parameters'. keep pill compact so list doesn't wrap.
Maya (Eng): doable. implementation note: make pill a button with aria-expanded, and animate max-height to avoid layout shift. debounce validation state updates (250ms).
Jules (A11y): accessibility notes: 1) pill must be reachable via Tab and announce aria-expanded state. 2) when expanded, focus should move to first required field. 3) if a value is autofilled, announce 'autofilled from last run'.
Ethan (PM): analytics to add: param_pill_toggle, copy_signature_click, autofill_accept. include fn_name and workspace_id.
Lina (DevEx): microcopy proposal for copy action: tooltip 'Copy signature (for API/CLI)'. aria-label: 'Copy function signature for calculateQuote'. thoughts?
Omar (Design): prefer shorter tooltip. aria-label sounds good but keep it without full signature to avoid verbosity. full signature can be in visual tooltip.
Maya (Eng): agree. clipboard should be plain text. after copy, emit live region: 'Copied signature for calculateQuote'.
ci-bot: build passed for playground-param-pill v0.1 -> staging.
Lina (DevEx): action items: Omar -> final mock with focus states; Maya -> prototype aria-expanded and debounce; Jules -> short a11y checklist. target: next design review.
Ethan (PM): adding ticket to sprint board. thanks all :thumbsup:
